tests.title: API 1: a city's debit and credit totals
API 2: one user's totals in a city
API 3: a summary of every user in a city
API 3 saves its response to a JSON file
Unknown cities and users get a 404
The user id in the path is a number
A 404 saves no file; each city gets its own file

bugs.why: the totals helper isn't written yet: it returns 0 for both totals
bugs.fix: Add up the amounts of the DEBIT transactions and of the CREDIT transactions separately.

bugs.why: API 1 isn't written yet: the handler answers 501
bugs.fix: Keep the transactions of the city; 404 with {"message": "No transactions found"} when there are none, else 200 with their totals.

bugs.why: API 2 isn't written yet: the handler answers 501
bugs.fix: Keep the transactions whose userId equals the id in the path (as a number) and whose city matches; 404 when none, else their totals.

bugs.why: API 3 isn't written yet: the handler answers 501
bugs.fix: Group the city's transactions by userId (sorted), build {userId, totalDebit, totalCredit} for each, save the array, return it; 404 when the city has none.

bugs.fix: Create the output folder if needed and write the data as JSON to output/{city}.json.
